meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 装好后,当你要做发布前检查时,Claude 会先找出上次 npm 发布以来的全部改动,按模块分组逐个深审,再做一轮整体复核,最后给出发布风险、版本号升级建议和更新日志草稿。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求做发布前评审时才接管,例如提到“pre-publish review”、“release review”等说法;单纯说发布或上线不会触发,由 /publish 直接发布。

say.note: 会先列出未发布的改动,再逐项审。

say.text: 这次的改动可以发布吗?先做发布前评审
say.note: 输出各改动组结论与阻塞问题。

say.text: 评审未发布的改动,并起草更新日志
say.note: 附带版本号建议与更新日志草稿。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a pre-publish review, Claude detects changes since the last npm release, analyzes each change group, runs a holistic gate review, and reports release risk, a version bump recommendation and a changelog draft.
howto.when_en: Runs only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. “pre-publish review” or “release review”. A plain publish or release request does not trigger it — /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Is this changeset safe to publish? Review it first.
Review unpublished changes and draft the changelog.
say_en.note: You get a changelog draft and a risk verdict.
